{{Quote|Hello. I am A5 S5, a tending droid. May I take your ice cream order?|Otonon Tracks|<ref name="SWG:FonatF" />}}
'''Otonon Tracks''', officially designated as '''A5 S5''', was a tending [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who worked for [[The Ice Cream Man]].

==Biography==
He was situated in the [[Smuggler Outpost|Smuggler's Outpost]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], and took [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] orders for customers.

He previously worked at a factory that manufactured fried ice cream fryers, including the ones used by the Ice Cream Man. Other former workers from that factory included [[Nore Brrea]], [[Lepwalk C'han]], and [[Tombl Blaus]].

==Behind the scenes==
Otonon Tracks was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FonatF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Otonon Tracks was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Portable Deep Fryer|"Portable Deep Fryer" collection]] introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
